title: Kiln — Pottery Wheel Studio
description: Throw a pot on a spinning wheel, flute and twist it, glaze and fire it, then download the mesh as an .obj.
concept: A ceramics studio that models a surface of revolution in software — no WebGL, just Canvas 2D. Drag on the spinning clay and the wall follows your finger; smooth it true, cut throwing grooves with a rib, or shape the cross-section from the side. Flutes, twist and ten real kiln glazes change the form and its surface, and the kiln animation fades raw clay into fired glaze. Every pot exports as a PNG render or a normals-included .obj mesh, saves to a localStorage shelf, and packs its whole profile into a share link.
features: Throw on the wheel — Shape, Smooth and Rib tools with brush width and pressure
Eight starting forms plus a draggable cross-section profile editor
Fluting, flute count and twist, with ten kiln glazes and a raw/fired animation
Live measurements — height, widest point and volume in millilitres
Export a 1600×1200 PNG render or a quad .obj mesh with vertex normals
localStorage shelf with rendered thumbnails, plus URL-hash share links
tech: Painter's algorithm with quad-strip gradient runs
Blinn-Phong shading baked into linear gradients

interaction.mouse: Drag on the pot to throw it — the wall follows the pointer; scroll to zoom; shift-drag or the Orbit tool to turn the view.
interaction.click: Pick a starting form, a tool or a glaze; Fire runs the kiln; PNG / OBJ / Share export the pot.
interaction.touch: One finger throws, two fingers pinch to zoom and orbit; the profile editor takes touch too.
interaction.keyboard: 1–4 pick tools, Space stops the wheel, F fires, E exports a PNG, S saves to the shelf, R resets.
